caption: The drawing depicts two human figures standing opposite each other, both wearing hats and long coats, each with visible beards and boots. Both figures are holding onto a large two-handled saw with a serrated edge, positioned vertically between them. The saw is actively cutting through a horizontal log that rests atop another log, which is parallel and underneath. The image is rendered entirely in shades of brown on an off-white background, giving the appearance of a monochromatic, wood-toned palette. The figures, the saw, and the logs are all composed in simple, stylized shapes without intricate detail, and there is no background or additional objects present in the composition.
title: Lumbering
